gloss: cutting into pieces; severing (of roads, lines)

definitions.gloss: cutting into pieces; severing (of roads, lines)
definitions.explanation: Being cut at many points so that a network no longer connects; used mostly of roads, railways and supply lines after a disaster.

examples.japanese: ⟦{道路|どうろ}→道路：01481_douro⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{寸断|すんだん}⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The roads were cut off in many places.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{鉄道|てつどう}→鉄道：03550_tetsudou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{各地|かくち}→各地：00155_kakuchi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{寸断|すんだん}⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The earthquake severed the railway in many places.

examples.japanese: ⟦{豪雨|ごうう}→豪雨：05860_gouu⟧⟦による→による：28349_niyoru⟧⟦{土砂崩|どしゃくず}れ→土砂崩れ：09257_doshakuzure⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{交通網|こうつうもう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{寸断|すんだん}⟦され→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{村|むら}→村：02261_mura⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{孤立|こりつ}→孤立：12229_koritsu⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Landslides from the torrential rain severed the transport network and cut the village off.

notes:
USAGE:
Almost always passive ({寸断|すんだん}⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧) and about infrastructure. {寸|すん} is an old unit of length (about 3 cm), so the word pictures something cut into short pieces.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{道路|どうろ}→道路：01481_douro⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{寸断|すんだん}⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧: roads are cut off
- {交通網|こうつうもう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{寸断|すんだん}: the severing of transport links
- ⟦{物流|ぶつりゅう}→物流：05137_butsuryuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{寸断|すんだん}⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧: supply chains are broken

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{切断|せつだん}→切断：20497_setsudan⟧: cutting, severing (a single cut)
- {不通|ふつう}: out of service (railways, phone lines)
